newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends slightly lower, awaits BoE meet.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends slightly lower, awaits BoE meet.

text.p: Britain's leading share index fell for the third straight session on Monday but ended off the day's lowest level after Wall Street recovered from an early sell-off.

UK investors braced for the two-day Bank of England meeting on interest rates, starting Wednesday, and a further batch of earnings reports, after today's strong results from HSBC Holdings and Pearson Plc.
The FTSE 100 of leading shares ended 3.6 points lower at 4,895.7. Volume was light at 536.4 million shares by 1530 GMT while decliners led advancers by a 64 to 35 margin.
